name: HERMES_TAG_EFFICACY_OUTCOMES_LQ133B_20261107
comment: The tag engine counted actioned<>'none' as a hit; 97% of research rows counted as successes
(directive_hit 18,171 of 25,661) so every tag's lift was engagement noise and tags were flagged
on a 0.3-1.2 point gap. A hit is now a positive 20-session outcome (hermes_outcome_ledger
.outcome_ret_20d) and a flag needs min_n graded rows, a >=5 point gap below base, and a one-sided
two-proportion z-test p <= 0.05. Hermetic: pure function, no DB, no network, no broker.
